verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Sai works across the entire operating system: desktop apps, browsers, file systems and terminals. It controls computers through UI, keyboard and mouse, clicking, typing and scrolling in ordinary desktop apps ('if you can click it, Sai can'), on cloud VMs or on the user's own macOS and Windows devices. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of keyboard-shortcut handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-application OS control.
